Maria Lopez.description: conversing about Maria Lopez and Eddy Lin planning to meet at Hobbs Cafe to discuss tuning systems, physics, and collaborate on their next project while having dinner or coffee. @ <persona> Eddy Lin
chat: Maria Lopez
Hey Eddy, I just saw you walking back to your dorm. Did you finish up at the library okay? Maybe we could grab something to eat or hang out a bit before you head in?
Eddy Lin
Hi Maria! Yeah, I just finished up some work and was feeling a bit lonely. It would be great to grab dinner or maybe even head over to your place if you're still streaming?
Maria Lopez
Sure, Eddy! I'm actually wrapping up my stream in about an hour if you're free to chat or grab something. Let’s meet at Hobbs Cafe around 9:30 PM?
Eddy Lin
Sounds good, Maria! See you at Hobbs Cafe then. Looking forward to it.
Maria Lopez
Great, I'll see you there then! Feel free to let me know if you need anything in particular from the cafe.
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Maria! I'll see you at Hobbs Cafe then. Maybe we can continue our discussion about tuning systems and physics over some coffee?
Maria Lopez
Sure, that sounds fun! I'm always up for diving deeper into those topics. See you in a bit at Hobbs Cafe.
Eddy Lin
Awesome, looking forward to that. Maybe we can also discuss any ideas you have for our next collaboration on tuning systems and physics?
Maria Lopez
Sounds like a plan, Eddy. I have some notes from our last meeting that we can review too. See you soon!
Eddy Lin
That would be great, Maria. I'll bring my notes as well and we can brainstorm some more ideas together at Hobbs Cafe.
Maria Lopez
Great, Eddy! I'll make sure to organize my thoughts and notes before we meet. See you in a bit!
Eddy Lin
Sounds good, Maria. I'll make sure to bring my laptop so we can look up some references or diagrams for our discussion on tuning systems and physics. See you then!
Maria Lopez
That sounds perfect, Eddy. I'll make sure to bring my sketchbook if we want to jot down any new ideas or diagrams during our discussion. See you soon at Hobbs Cafe!
Eddy Lin
Thanks, Maria. It will be great to continue our discussion and explore more about tuning systems and physics. See you at Hobbs Cafe!
Maria Lopez
Sounds great, Eddy! I'll bring my laptop too so we can both look up any additional resources we might need. Can't wait to connect over some coffee and delve deeper into our interests!
Eddy Lin
That sounds fantastic, Maria. I’ll make sure to bring my notes and any resources that might be helpful for our discussion on tuning systems and physics. See you at Hobbs Cafe!
